$comment: doc-stats policy for aximprint. `command` runs from the repo root on every --check (turn-end and before every commit) — treat this file as executable code and review it like a hook. CHANGELOG and LESSONS are deliberately NOT in `files`: their dated entries quote the number that was true then, and are supposed to. NOTE ON THE COMMANDS: each one is written `out=$(...) && printf` on purpose. doc-stats' `_compute_one` ignores the subprocess return code, so a pytest collect that ERRORS still yields whatever `(\d+) tests collected` it managed to print — which is how a bare-`python` run once reported 3 tests and false drift against a correct doc. The `&&` makes a failed command print nothing, so the counter comes back unknown instead of confidently wrong. Use `.venv/bin/python`, never bare `python`: without the venv, 4 of 5 test files fail to import.

plugins.command: out=$(.venv/bin/python -c 'import aximprint.ingest.zeek; from aximprint.ingest.base import _REGISTRY; print(len(_REGISTRY))') && printf '%s' "$out"
